test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following launched the Home Rule League in September 1916 at Madras?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Annie Besant**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 
 
**Annie Besant:**

 
 
• Annie Besant launched the Home Rule League in Madras (now Chennai) in September 1916.
 
• She was a prominent theosophist, social reformer, and advocate for Indian self-rule.
 
• Her Home Rule League aimed to achieve self-government for India through constitutional means.
 
• She played a crucial role in mobilizing public opinion and raising awareness about the demand for Home Rule.
 
• Her work was instrumental in the Indian National Movement.
 
• She was a very effective orator.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
**Sucheta Kriplani:**

 
 
• Sucheta Kriplani was an Indian freedom fighter and politician.
 
• She is best known for being India's first female Chief Minister, serving in Uttar Pradesh.
 
• While she was involved in the freedom movement, she was not associated with the launch of the Home Rule League.
 
• She was involved in the quit India movement.
 
• She worked closely with Gandhi during the partition.
 
 
 
• 
 
**Lokmanya Tilak:**

 
 
• Lokmanya Tilak also launched a Home Rule League, but his was in April 1916, in Belgaum.
 
• He was a prominent nationalist leader known for his advocacy of Swaraj (self-rule).
 
• His Home Rule League focused on Maharashtra and the Central Provinces.
 
• He was known for his famous slogan, "Swaraj is my birthright, and I shall have it!"
 
• He was a strong advocate for indian independence.
 
 
 
• 
 
**Rash Behari Bose:**

 
 
• Rash Behari Bose was a revolutionary leader involved in various anti-British activities.
 
• He was a key figure in the Ghadar Conspiracy and later played a role in the Indian Independence League and the formation of the Indian National Army.
 
• He was not directly involved in the Home Rule League movement.
 
• He was a key organizer of revolutionary activities.
 
• He spent time in Japan during his revolutionary activities.
